newsitem.title: CANADA: Hudson's Bay sets 6.25 pct debenture.
newsitem.headline: Hudson's Bay sets 6.25 pct debenture.

text.p: Hudson's Bay Company on Monday set a C$100 million 6.25 percent debenture due 2002, said a member of the syndicate underwriting the issue.
The issue carried an initial offering price of C$99.673 with an offering yield of 6.321 percent, 100 basis points over the Government of Canada 8.5 percent bond due April 1, 2002.
The underwriters have the option of expanding the principal amount of the issue to C$125 million, depending on its reception in the marketplace, said the syndicate member.

The proceeds of the debenture will be added to the general funds of the company and used to fund capital expenditures, repay existing debt and for other general corporate purposes, according to the term sheet of the new issue.
The issue may be purchased by the company for cancellation at any time in the market, by tender or private contract, the term sheet said..
RBC Dominion Securities Inc is the lead manager of the new issue. Other members of the syndicate include ScotiaMcLeod Inc, CIBC Wood Gundy Inc, and Toronto Dominion Securities Inc.
